v.why: Removing a direct 3x3 conv edge to the output loses far more accuracy than removing a skip or weak op.
Replacing a skip with a 3x3 conv adds capacity, giving a larger gain than replacing pool or 1x1.
Swapping a 3x3 conv for a skip discards learned capacity and costs a lot.
Removing a weak pooling edge at the input helps, unlike removing an informative conv edge.
Upgrading a skip on the final edge to a 3x3 conv gives a big gain.
Replacing a pool with a skip improves gradient flow and accuracy.
Removing a skip edge costs less than removing a conv edge, so the edit does relatively better here.
Replacing a skip with pooling on the final edge degrades accuracy.
Replacing the direct skip with a 1x1 conv loses the easy-optimization shortcut, hurting accuracy.
Replacing a skip on the middle edge with a conv adds useful capacity.

raw:
These ten hypotheses come from the 20 experiments plus general NAS-Bench-201 knowledge: convolutions carry most of the accuracy, and the direct skip into the output node is cheap to lose. I did not run any further experiments to test them. The evidence is thin for some of them (hypotheses 4, 9 and 10 rest on a single observation each, and 6 and 7 on two), and hypothesis 3 is mainly extrapolated from known behaviour of the space.

1. Removing edge 3 hurts more when edge 3 currently holds a 3x3 conv (experiments 5 and 8). Replacing a skip or a 1x1 conv costs little (experiments 15 and 16).
2. Upgrading edge 4 to a 3x3 conv helps more when it currently holds a skip (experiment 13, +8.14 on CIFAR-100) than when it holds a pool or 1x1 conv (experiments 18 and 20).
3. Replacing edge 2's op with a skip hurts more when edge 2 currently holds a 3x3 conv (experiment 9).
4. Removing edge 0 helps more when edge 0 currently holds an avg-pool (experiment 15).
5. Switching edge 5 to a 3x3 conv helps more when edge 5 currently holds a skip (experiment 11).
6. Switching edge 4 to a skip helps more when edge 4 currently holds an avg-pool (experiment 4).
7. Removing edge 3 does better when edge 3 currently holds a skip than when it holds a conv.
8. Switching edge 5 to an avg-pool hurts more when edge 5 currently holds a skip (experiment 12).
9. Switching edge 3 to a 1x1 conv does worse when edge 3 currently holds a skip (experiment 19).
10. Switching edge 2 to a 1x1 conv helps more when edge 2 currently holds a skip (experiment 17).
